fields.description: Where to read the value from on the ERPNext Item document.

fields.label: Field / Value
fields.description: Item Field: field name (e.g. weight_per_unit, item_name, item_code). Item Barcode: barcode_type to match (e.g. EAN-13), leave blank for first barcode. Item Attribute: attribute name (e.g. Color, Size). Custom Value: literal text always sent as-is.

fields.label: Magento Attribute Code
fields.description: Magento product attribute code to set (e.g. isbn, ean, color, manufacturer).
